# Skeldergate Freight - island runs

Crossings are booked per vehicle and the fare comes from the class the vehicle
falls in. The desk quotes from the fare sheet below when a customer asks what a
run will add to the bill.

turns.prompt: The Portmore delivery goes over on Thursday and the customer wants to know what the crossing adds to their bill. What is the fare for that run?
They are sending the rigid. What is the crossing fare for the rigid vehicle? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
